scope: Only the new C500 INT8 MMA implementation is executed; previous versions are read from fixed archived JSON only
method: One fresh worker and one input allocation per case. The common harness passes one set of device pointers to a wrapper that executes two native 7-round batches on those same buffers (3 warmups and 2 grouped calls per round). CPU validation runs after all 14 event samples. No old-version libraries are loaded or timed.
grid_metrics_note: The unchanged common harness assumes 16x16; the driver corrects reporting-only grid counts to the actual 32x32 output tile.
reproduction_script:
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, ctypes, datetime, hashlib, importlib.util, json, statistics, subprocess, sys

ROOT=Path('/root/MOE/C500_int8_02All')
REPORTS=ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/reports'
SOURCE=ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/optimized_gemm.cpp'
LIBRARY=ROOT/'02_optimized_gemm/libmoe_int8_shared.so'
SHAPES=ROOT/'benchmarks/baseline_shapes_2026-10-16.json'
OUTPUT=REPORTS/'mma_results_2026-10-20.json'
SETTINGS=dict(seed=20261016,warmup_per_batch=3,iterations=2,batches=2,rounds_per_batch=7,total_samples=14,check_samples=256)
BASELINES=dict(naive=REPORTS/'naive_results_2026-10-20.json',shared=REPORTS/'shared_results_2026-10-20.json',
               vector=REPORTS/'vector_comparison_2026-10-20.json',vector_g129_retest=REPORTS/'vector_g129_contiguous_retest_2026-10-20.json',
               register=REPORTS/'register_comparison_2026-10-20.json')
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def signatures():return dict(source_sha256=digest(SOURCE),library_sha256=digest(LIBRARY),harness_sha256=digest(ROOT/'benchmarks/bench_shapes.py'))

def worker(index):
    import torch
    torch.cuda.set_device(0)
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench',ROOT/'benchmarks/bench_shapes.py')
    bench=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(bench)
    case=json.loads(SHAPES.read_text())[index]
    args=argparse.Namespace(warmup=3,iterations=2,rounds=14,check_samples=256,seed=20261016)
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(str(LIBRARY));fn=lib.moe_int8_benchmark
    fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_void_p]*6+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.c_void_p]+[ctypes.c_int]*4+[ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)]
    fn.restype=ctypes.c_int
    batches=[];pointers=None
    def two_batches(*params):
        nonlocal pointers
        assert len(params)==16 and params[-2]==14
        pointers=list(params[:6]);times=params[-1]
        for batch in range(2):
            out=ctypes.cast(ctypes.byref(times,batch*7*ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_float)),ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))
            rc=fn(*params[:14],7,out)
            if rc:return rc
            samples=list(times)[batch*7:(batch+1)*7]
            batches.append(dict(batch=batch,samples_ms=samples,median_ms=statistics.median(samples)))
        return 0
    before=signatures()
    result=bench.run_case(case,two_batches,args)
    import math
    bound=case['capacity'] if case['layout']=='masked' else min(sum(case['counts']),65536)
    launched=math.ceil(case['n']/32)*math.ceil(bound/32)*len(case['counts'])
    useful=math.ceil(case['n']/32)*sum(math.ceil(m/32) for m in case['counts'])
    samples=result['samples_ms'];median=statistics.median(samples)
    result.update(block_m=32,block_n=32,launched_blocks=launched,useful_blocks=useful,
                  useful_block_fraction=useful/launched if launched else 0,
                  mean_ms=statistics.mean(samples),range_over_median=(max(samples)-min(samples))/median,
                  batches=batches,fixed_buffer_pointers=pointers)
    assert result['status']=='PASS' and len(samples)==14 and len(batches)==2
    assert before==signatures()
    record=dict(result=result,signatures=before,torch_version=torch.__version__,device=torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),
                visible_memory_bytes=torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory,mx_smi=bench.command_output(['mx-smi']))
    Path(f'/tmp/moe_mma_case_{index}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print('MMA_CASE_PASS',index,case['name'],'median',median,'variation_pct',result['range_over_median']*100,flush=True)

def main():
    if len(sys.argv)>1:worker(int(sys.argv[1]));return
    assert not OUTPUT.exists(),'Never overwrite a completed performance report'
    original=signatures();baselines={k:dict(path=str(p),sha256=digest(p)) for k,p in BASELINES.items()}
    report=dict(timestamp_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),scope='Only the new C500 INT8 MMA implementation is executed; previous versions are read from fixed archived JSON only',
                method='One fresh worker and one input allocation per case. The common harness passes one set of device pointers to a wrapper that executes two native 7-round batches on those same buffers (3 warmups and 2 grouped calls per round). CPU validation runs after all 14 event samples. No old-version libraries are loaded or timed.',
                settings=SETTINGS,signatures=original,source=str(SOURCE),library=str(LIBRARY),
                shapes_sha256=hashlib.sha256(SHAPES.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest(),fixed_baseline_reports=baselines,
                grid_metrics_note='The unchanged common harness assumes 16x16; the driver corrects reporting-only grid counts to the actual 32x32 output tile.',
                reproduction_script=Path(__file__).read_text(),driver_sha256=digest(Path(__file__)),results=[],workers=[])
    for i,case in enumerate(json.loads(SHAPES.read_text())):
        print('MMA_CASE',i+1,case['name'],flush=True)
        out=Path(f'/tmp/moe_mma_case_{i}.json')
        if out.exists():out.unlink()
        completed=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(Path(__file__).resolve()),str(i)])
        assert completed.returncode==0 and out.exists(),(i,completed.returncode)
        data=json.loads(out.read_text());assert data['signatures']==original and data['result']['case']==case
        report['results'].append(data['result']);report['workers'].append({k:v for k,v in data.items() if k!='result'})
        OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    assert signatures()==original
    assert all(digest(Path(v['path']))==v['sha256'] for v in baselines.values())
    report['status']='PASS';OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    print('MMA_ALL_PASS',len(report['results']),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
